description: This file defines an interface for managing the command name hierarchy within a process environment, including functions to append to the hierarchy, retrieve the current hierarchy, and release resources.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_append_hierarchy
methods.description: Appends the current command name to the hierarchy maintained in the environment.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_get_hierarchy
methods.description: Retrieves the current command name hierarchy for the current process.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_release
methods.description: Releases any resources associated with the command name hierarchy.
